nav.tagline: Know your group. Choose the right study. Prepare with confidence.

landing.title: Plan studies your group actually needs
landing.subtitle: Members answer a short, anonymous survey. You get a picture of the group's Bible knowledge gaps and life needs, study recommendations from your church's approved catalog, and a ready-to-use session plan.
landing.f1Body: 6–8 minutes on a phone, in English or 繁體中文. Anonymous by default — it's not a test.
landing.f2Body: See shared gaps, life needs and hidden needs, with small-group privacy safeguards.
landing.f3Body: Recommendations only come from resources your pastor has allowed — BibleProject, RightNow Media and your own.
landing.f4Body: Opener, scripture, questions for beginners to mature believers, application and prayer focus.
landing.signInHint: We'll email you a magic link — no password needed.
landing.checkEmail: Check your email for a sign-in link.
landing.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
landing.demoHint: No account needed. Demo data is stored locally and can be reset at any time.
landing.demoSurveyHint: See what group members fill in on their phones.

onboarding.title: Set up your account
onboarding.subtitle: Pastors create the church; leaders join with the invite code from their pastor.
onboarding.pastorHint: Create your church and curate the study catalog.
onboarding.leaderHint: Join your church with the invite code.

leader.title: My care groups
leader.subtitle: Create a season, share the survey link, then see your group's needs and recommendations.
leader.noGroups: No groups yet — create your first group below.
leader.responses: {n, plural, =0 {No responses} one {# response} other {# responses}}

season.responsesCount: {n, plural, =0 {No responses yet} one {# response} other {# responses}}
season.crisisTitle: {n, plural, one {One response may need care} other {# responses may need care}}
season.crisisBody: Someone indicated they may be going through a very hard time. Their identity is not shown. Consider gently reminding the whole group that you're available, sharing support lines (e.g. Samaritan Befrienders HK 2389 2222) and involving your pastor.
season.shareHint: Send this link or QR code to your members. Responses are anonymous unless a member chooses to share their name.
season.qrAlt: QR code for the survey link
season.draftHint: Open the survey to start collecting responses.
season.kGuard: Group breakdowns appear once at least {min} members respond (currently {n}). This protects members' anonymity.
season.commentsHint: Names, phone numbers and emails are removed automatically.
season.observationsHint: How much does the group need each area, from what you've seen? Your estimates help spot hidden needs.
season.plansEmpty: Pick a recommendation to draft a session plan.
season.hiddenHint: High need in the answers, but not something the group asked for or you expected.

hiddenReason.low_interest: Few members picked this as an interest

plan.tieredHint: Use the tier that fits each person — the group has a wide range of Bible knowledge.

pastor.title: Study catalog
pastor.subtitle: Choose which resources your leaders can be recommended, set priorities and review AI tags.
pastor.importHint: Use the template for RightNow Media series or your own resources. Only metadata and links are stored — members open RightNow content with your church's subscription.
pastor.imported: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing imported} one {Imported # resource} other {Imported # resources}}
pastor.catalogHint: Only allowed resources are recommended. Priority (0–1) gently boosts a resource.
pastor.notInCatalog: {n, plural, one {# resource is} other {# resources are}} not in your catalog yet.
pastor.reviewHint: Tick the topics this resource really covers and set how central each one is. Approved tags are marked as reviewed.

survey.notFoundBody: Please check the link with your group leader.
survey.closedBody: Thanks for your interest — please ask your leader if it should still be open.
survey.introTitle: Help your leader plan our next season
survey.introBody: Your answers help your leader choose studies that fit where the group really is.
survey.introNotTest: It's not a test — "I'm not sure" is a perfectly good answer.
survey.introAnonymous: Anonymous by default. Your leader only sees group totals.

A.title: About you
A.hint: A little context about where you are.

B1.title: Your confidence
B1.hint: 1 = not at all confident, 5 = very confident.

B2.title: Quick Bible questions
B2.hint: Not a test! Choose "I'm not sure" whenever you like.

D.title: Life lately
D.hint: Optional and anonymous — it helps your leader care well.

survey.shareName: Share my name with my leader (optional)
survey.privacyNote: We don't store your IP address or device details. Free text is scrubbed of names and contact details.
survey.errorClosed: This survey is no longer open.
survey.errorInvalid: Something went wrong — please try again.
survey.thanksBody: Your answers have been sent anonymously. Your leader will use the group's results to plan the coming weeks.
survey.supportTitle: If you need someone to talk to
survey.supportBody: These Hong Kong support lines are free and confidential.
survey.crisisTitle: You don't have to face this alone
survey.crisisBody: It sounds like things may be really hard right now. Please reach out to one of these 24-hour lines, or call 999 if you are in immediate danger. Your leader has been notified anonymously that someone in the group may need support — your name has not been shared.
